sections.title: The `Tesselator` {#the-tessellator}
sections.summary: The Tesselator is the main class used to render things in Minecraft. It is a singleton, meaning that there is only one instance of it in the game. You can get the instance using Tesselator.

sections.title: The `BufferBuilder` {#the-bufferbuilder}
sections.summary: The BufferBuilder is the class used to format and upload rendering data to OpenGL. It is used to create a buffer, which is then uploaded to OpenGL to draw.

sections.title: The `PoseStack` {#the-matrixstack}
sections.summary: After learning how to write to the BufferBuilder, you might be wondering how to transform your model - or even animate it. This is where the PoseStack class comes in.

sections.title: Quaternions (Rotating Things) {#quaternions-rotating-things}
sections.summary: Quaternions are a way of representing rotations in 3D space. They are used to rotate the top matrix on the PoseStack via the mulPose(Quaternion, x, y, z) method.
